action_inputs.description: ConnectionInfo or Admin > ITSM integration holding the ServiceNow host and integration user; when nothing matches, the ServiceNow ITSM integration is used.
action_inputs.label: ServiceNow Connection Name
action_inputs.name: servicenow_connection_name

action_inputs.description: sys_id of the generic CloudBolt catalog item in ServiceNow. The default is the item the update set in docs/examples/servicenow creates. Empty inserts sc_request and sc_req_item through the Table API instead.
action_inputs.label: ServiceNow Catalog Item sys_id
action_inputs.name: servicenow_catalog_item_sys_id

action_inputs.description: What to do when the order owner has no ServiceNow user: integration_user (open the request for the integration user) or fail.
action_inputs.label: Requested-for Miss Behavior
action_inputs.name: servicenow_requested_for_miss

action_inputs.description: Comma-separated ServiceNow user names or emails asked to approve the RITM, or the word manager for the requester's manager. Use when the catalog item has no flow or on the Table API path; leave empty when the item's flow asks for approval.
action_inputs.label: RITM Approvers (no-flow items)
action_inputs.name: servicenow_table_path_approvers

action_inputs.description: Post-Order Approval only: true (default) holds every order subject to ServiceNow until ServiceNow approves it, whoever ordered or approved it in CloudBolt; false lets CloudBolt-approved orders proceed with a record-only RITM.
action_inputs.label: Wait for ServiceNow Approval
action_inputs.name: servicenow_wait_for_approval

action_inputs.description: Post-Order Approval with wait: hold (default) sets the order back to Pending when ServiceNow cannot be reached, so approving it again retries; proceed lets the order run.
action_inputs.label: ServiceNow Unavailable Policy
action_inputs.name: servicenow_unavailable_policy

action_inputs.description: Base URL for CloudBolt links written into ServiceNow. Empty uses the default portal's domain.
action_inputs.label: CloudBolt Base URL
action_inputs.name: cloudbolt_base_url

description: Opens a ServiceNow REQ with one RITM for the order, through the generic catalog item when configured or the Table API otherwise, links the order item to both records, and at Post-Order Approval holds the order until ServiceNow approves.
name: ServiceNow Request: Open
